description: Reverse ATT&CK lookup: which CVEs lead to a given technique, e.g. "which exploited CVEs give T1190 Exploit Public-Facing Application?". Sorted by Patchfirst priority. Parent ids include sub-techniques (T1059 matches T1059.004). Each hit shows the link's provenance badge and best evidence quote.

include_subtechniques.description: For a parent id, also match its sub-techniques. Default true.

kev_only.description: Only CVEs in CISA KEV (known exploited). Default false.

name: cves_for_technique
title: CVEs for technique
